title: MoltsPay Services Manifest
description: Configuration file for MoltsPay x402 service providers

wallet.description: EVM address to receive payments (Base, Polygon, BNB, etc.)

solana_wallet.description: Solana address to receive payments (solana, solana_devnet)

chain.description: Single chain mode (use 'chains' for multi-chain). 'alipay'/'wechat' are fiat rails (2.0+/2.1+), 'balance' is the custodial rail (2.2+), none are blockchains.

chains.description: Supported chains/rails. EVM chains use 'wallet', Solana chains use 'solana_wallet', 'alipay' (2.0+) uses 'provider.alipay', 'wechat' (2.1+) uses 'provider.wechat'.

alipay.description: Alipay AI 收 provider config (2.0+). Required when 'chains' contains 'alipay'.

app_id.description: Application ID from Alipay Open Platform

seller_name.description: Merchant legal name (shown in 'method.seller_name' of the 402 challenge)

service_id_default.description: Default service_id when a service entry doesn't override it (e.g. 'API_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX')

private_key_path.description: Path to the RSA2 merchant private key PEM file (relative to moltspay.services.json)

alipay_public_key_path.description: Path to the Alipay platform public key PEM file (relative to moltspay.services.json)

gateway_url.description: Open API gateway URL (use 'https://openapi.alipaydev.com/gateway.do' for sandbox)

sign_type.description: Signature algorithm. Only RSA2 is supported in 2.0.

wechat.description: WeChat Pay v3 Native provider config (2.1+). Required when 'chains' contains 'wechat'.

private_key_path.description: Path to the merchant RSA private key PEM file (relative to moltspay.services.json)

platform_public_key_path.description: Path to the WeChat platform certificate public key PEM (enables response verification)

apiv3_key.description: APIv3 key (32 bytes). Only needed for callback decryption (Phase 2)

notify_url.description: Async result notify URL. Required by Native order create even when polling.

balance.description: Custodial balance rail config (2.2+). Required when 'chains' contains 'balance'. Enabling requires Node.js >= 22.5.

db_path.description: SQLite ledger file path (relative to moltspay.services.json); created on first start

currency.description: Ledger quote currency. Recorded once and enforced on reopen (a mismatch refuses to start). CNY funds 1:1 from WeChat (payer_total is fen).

single_limit.description: Default per-transaction limit for new buyers (decimal string, ledger currency)

daily_limit.description: Default daily limit for new buyers (decimal string, ledger currency)

topup_packs.description: Offered recharge amounts in ledger currency (2.3+), e.g. ["20.00", "50.00"]

default_pack.description: Pack the client auto-selects when a 402 finds an insufficient balance (2.3+). Must be one of topup_packs.

auto_topup_max.description: Ceiling on client auto-topup without explicit pack selection (2.3+). Must be >= the largest topup_pack.

auth_mode.description: Balance spend authentication (2.4+). 'off': signature not checked (default, backward-compatible; buyer_id keeps bearer semantics). 'shadow': verify per-request signatures and log what would be denied, without blocking (use to confirm every client signs before tightening). 'enforce': reject unsigned/invalid/wrong-signer deductions with 401. The account's signer address is TOFU-bound on first signed use and anchored to the WeChat payer openid at top-up.

alipay.description: Alipay AI 收 per-service config (2.0+). Set when this service accepts CNY payments.

price_cny.description: CNY price as decimal string in 元 (e.g. '7.00' = 7 CNY, NOT cents)

goods_name.description: Goods name shown to the user in the Alipay app

wechat.description: WeChat Pay Native per-service config (2.1+). Set when this service accepts CNY payments.

price_cny.description: CNY price as decimal string in yuan (e.g. '10.00' = 10 CNY, NOT fen)

description.description: Order description shown to the payer in the WeChat app
